Highly motivated and organized project leader focused on providing high quality and technical research and analysis across a breadth of topics and who engages with internal and external partners to ensure a comprehensive approach that delivers results.

Policy expert with a passion for federal, state and local policy including transportation, immigration, telecommunication, education, foreign policy, and a deep understanding of local land use and zoning law, particularly within the Northern Virginia region. 

Effective manager with experience in data design and analysis, media, communication, public relations and all levels of political campaigns.

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
